summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares itself as a CircleCI orb but its preinstall lifecycle script (`preinstall: node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727 KB obfuscated JavaScript file (`math_init.js`). The alternate-runtime approach bypasses Node-based install-time inspection, and the payload itself is obfuscated with a rotating string/const array (`n7gIxM`), a shuffle routine (`WV8StW`), and a custom-alphabet character decoder (`hc1jfK9`). The preinstall script `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and indirection maps despite performing only download-and-exec logic, which conflicts with the declared purpose of a CircleCI orb definition package. On `npm install`, the installer's host executes attacker-controlled, heavily obfuscated code under a freshly-downloaded runtime, with no relationship to CircleCI orb functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
